app/src/routes/+page.svelte:56 — reset:false/replace are the current kit-3 option names, not novel choices

justification.rationale: No experimental APIs are used, and every very-new API used is exactly what current stable docs prescribe (deprecated-API replacements), each buying something the old API couldn't; the only blemish is a leftover of the OLD api (noScroll/keepFocus at pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:10), not an unjustified new one.

findings.issue: goto(url, { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true, replace: true }) uses options that SvelteKit 3 removed and replaced with a single reset option (3.0.0-next.13 breaking change); the old options are silently ignored, so the intended scroll/focus preservation on game change doesn't happen.
findings.suggestion: Use goto(url, { reset: false, replace: true }) — consistent with the reset usage in app/src/routes/+page.svelte:55 — and drop the dead options.

findings.issue: The home page's core filter/pagination UX rests on goto's shallow routing options, which have only been stable since SvelteKit 3.0.0 (2026-10-01, previewed 2026-07-29) — the newest stable surface in the framework.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is since it's the documented replacement for deprecated pushState/replaceState; monitor 3.x patch releases for behavior changes in shallow navigation.

findings.issue: state: {} and reset: false are defaults for shallow goto, so they're redundant (harmless, mildly self-documenting).
findings.suggestion: Drop the redundant options or keep them deliberately as documentation of shallow-goto defaults.

findings.issue: untrack is called at component initialization to compute an initial $state value, where there is no reactive context to untrack — a no-op misuse of a stable Svelte 5 API.
findings.suggestion: Write let sortKey = $state(table.hasLevel ? 'level' : 'move') and import untrack only if a real effect-context need appears.

summary: This app uses zero experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs; it is instead an early adopter of SvelteKit 3 (stable 2026-10-01), leaning on its newest goto shallow-routing options, #lib imports and vite-plugin config in central places — all of which are the documented replacements for deprecated APIs. The new usage is well contained and justified, with one drift bug where removed noScroll/keepFocus options survive in the Pokémon detail page. Experimental reach is effectively nil; the only cost is being four weeks into a brand-new major version's stable surface.
